definition: Genetic algorithms have increasingly been applied to economics since the pioneering work by John H.
details: Miller in 1986. It has been used to characterize a variety of models including the cobweb model, the overlapping generations model, game theory, schedule optimization and asset pricing. Specifically, it has been used as a model to represent learning, rather than as a means for fitting a model.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. In plain words: Genetic algorithms have increasingly been applied to economics since the pioneering work by John H. Here is how it actually plays out: Miller in 1986. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. And that idea, made concrete, is Genetic algorithms in economics.
